text: The word of the Lord which came to Micah of Moresheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
Hear, O peoples, all of you,give heed, O earth, and all that is in it! [AA]Let the Lord God be witness against you,the Lord from his holy temple! [1]
For see, the Lord goes out from his place [AB]and descending, treads upon the heights of the earth. [2]
The mountains melt under himand the valleys split open,Like wax before the fire,like water poured down a slope.
All this is for the crime of Jacob,for the sins of the house of Israel. [3]What is the crime of Jacob? Is it not Samaria?And what is the sin of the house of Judah?Is it not Jerusalem?
So I will make Samaria a ruin in the field,a place to plant vineyards;I will throw its stones into the valley,and lay bare its foundations. [4]

All its carved figures shall be broken to pieces, [AC]all its wages shall be burned in the fire,and all its idols I will destroy.As the wages of a prostitute [5] it gathered them,and to the wages of a prostitute they shall return.
t[6] For this I will lament and wail,go barefoot and naked;I will utter lamentation like the jackals,mourning like the ostriches, [AD]
For her wound is incurable;it has come even to Judah.It has reached to the gate of my people,even to Jerusalem.
t[7] Do not announce it in Gath,do not weep at all;In Beth-leaphrahroll in the dust. [AE]
Pass by,you who dwell in Shaphir!The inhabitants of Zaanando not come forth from their city.There is lamentation in Beth-ezel.It will withdraw its support from you.
The inhabitants of Marothhope for good,But evil has come down from the Lordto the gate of Jerusalem.
Harness steeds to the chariots,inhabitants of Lachish;You are the beginning of sinfor daughter Zion,For in you were foundthe crimes of Israel.
Therefore you must give back the dowryto Moresheth-gath;The houses of Achzib [8] are a dry stream bedto the kings of Israel.
Again I will bring the conqueror to you,inhabitants of Mareshah;The glory of Israel shall comeeven to Adullam.
Make yourself bald, cut off your hair,for the children whom you cherish;Make yourself bald as a vulture,for they are taken from you into exile. [9]
